# Nvidia, AMD, and Intel Annual Revenue and Operating Income Comparison

**Supported**

NVDA revenue for the fiscal period ended 2025-01-26 was $130.497 billion [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html), up from $60.922 billion for 2024-01-28 [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html). NVDA net income for the fiscal period ended 2025-01-26 was $72.880 billion [Ebc64b283ab](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html), up from $29.760 billion for 2024-01-28 [E05bed4e2f8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of March 1, 2023, NVIDIA's reported annual revenue was $26,974,000,000 with an operating income of $4,224,000,000 for the fiscal year ended January 29, 2023 [E27fc4964d7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581023000017/0001045810-23-000017-index.html) [Ec91c36e46f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581023000017/0001045810-23-000017-index.html). AMD reported annual revenue of $23,601,000,000 and operating income of $1,264,000,000 for the period ended December 31, 2022 [Edc5f1b01cd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248823000047/0000002488-23-000047-index.html) [E18d36cf335](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248823000047/0000002488-23-000047-index.html). Intel reported annual revenue of $63,054,000,000 and operating income of $2,334,000,000 for the period ended December 31, 2022 [E1df1f1a619](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/0000050863-23-000006-index.html) [Eb353642586](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/0000050863-23-000006-index.html). Management discussions highlighted industry-wide inventory adjustments, macroeconomic uncertainty, and customer concentrations [E9f079b4607](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248823000047/amd-20221231.htm) [E294075c419](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/intc-20221231.htm) [Ef19157ab6f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581022000147/nvda-20220731.htm).

## What happened later

For the fiscal year ended January 28, 2024, NVIDIA reported revenue of $60,922,000,000 and operating income of $32,972,000,000, followed by revenue of $130,497,000,000 and operating income of $81,453,000,000 for the fiscal year ended January 26, 2025 [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [E8c58b8d2cd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [Edfa0a58d57](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). AMD reported revenue of $22,680,000,000 and operating income of $401,000,000 for the period ended December 30, 2023, and revenue of $25,785,000,000 and operating income of $1,900,000,000 for the period ended December 28, 2024 [Ed422eea5f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.html) [E2e09a06900](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [E40807037c2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.html) [Eaca1b81d9d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html). Intel reported revenue of $54,228,000,000 and operating income of $93,000,000 for the period ended December 30, 2023, followed by revenue of $53,101,000,000 and an operating loss of -$11,678,000,000 for the period ended December 28, 2024 [E7a1493ba18](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html) [E9825b28a5f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html) [Ee7da324732](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html) [E58906c3289](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing annual results through the outcome cutoff, NVIDIA operated on a fiscal year ending in late January (reporting periods ended 2024-01-28 and 2025-01-26), whereas AMD and Intel used calendar-aligned fiscal years ending in late December (reporting periods ended 2023-12-30 and 2024-12-28) [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [Ed422eea5f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.html) [E2e09a06900](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [E7a1493ba18](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html) [E9825b28a5f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html). NVIDIA achieved massive top-line and operating income expansion [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [E8c58b8d2cd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [Edfa0a58d57](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). AMD's revenue contracted in fiscal 2023 before increasing in 2024 [Ed422eea5f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.html) [E2e09a06900](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html), while Intel's revenue declined consecutively and operating profitability deteriorated into a severe loss by fiscal 2024 [E7a1493ba18](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html) [E9825b28a5f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html) [Ee7da324732](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html) [E58906c3289](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html). Peer profit directions diverged significantly [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [Ed422eea5f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.html) [E7a1493ba18](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html).

## Cross-examination

Filing disclosures provided qualitative warnings regarding cyclical downturns and customer concentration but did not contain formal quantitative guidance for fiscal 2024 or 2025 [E9f079b4607](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248823000047/amd-20221231.htm) [E294075c419](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/intc-20221231.htm) [Ef19157ab6f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581022000147/nvda-20220731.htm). Consequently, retrospective observation confirms reported financial outcomes but cannot validate unstated management forecasts for the post-as_of period [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [Ed422eea5f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.html) [E7a1493ba18](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html). Investor inquiries should examine how upcoming segment-level hardware demand will impact operating margins across these specific semiconductor companies.

## Limits

- Fiscal calendar offsets exist between NVIDIA's late-January fiscal year-end and AMD and Intel's late-December fiscal year-ends.
- NVIDIA annual capital expenditure data is unavailable within the supported XBRL metrics.

sections.title: What was knowable then
sections.text: As of March 1, 2023, NVIDIA's reported annual revenue was $26,974,000,000 with an operating income of $4,224,000,000 for the fiscal year ended January 29, 2023 [E27fc4964d7] [Ec91c36e46f]. AMD reported annual revenue of $23,601,000,000 and operating income of $1,264,000,000 for the period ended December 31, 2022 [Edc5f1b01cd] [E18d36cf335]. Intel reported annual revenue of $63,054,000,000 and operating income of $2,334,000,000 for the period ended December 31, 2022 [E1df1f1a619] [Eb353642586]. Management discussions highlighted industry-wide inventory adjustments, macroeconomic uncertainty, and customer concentrations [E9f079b4607] [E294075c419] [Ef19157ab6f].

sections.title: What happened later
sections.text: For the fiscal year ended January 28, 2024, NVIDIA reported revenue of $60,922,000,000 and operating income of $32,972,000,000, followed by revenue of $130,497,000,000 and operating income of $81,453,000,000 for the fiscal year ended January 26, 2025 [E1d1ed85017] [E47912effca] [E8c58b8d2cd] [Edfa0a58d57]. AMD reported revenue of $22,680,000,000 and operating income of $401,000,000 for the period ended December 30, 2023, and revenue of $25,785,000,000 and operating income of $1,900,000,000 for the period ended December 28, 2024 [Ed422eea5f5] [E2e09a06900] [E40807037c2] [Eaca1b81d9d]. Intel reported revenue of $54,228,000,000 and operating income of $93,000,000 for the period ended December 30, 2023, followed by revenue of $53,101,000,000 and an operating loss of -$11,678,000,000 for the period ended December 28, 2024 [E7a1493ba18] [E9825b28a5f] [Ee7da324732] [E58906c3289].

sections.title: The peer test
sections.text: Comparing annual results through the outcome cutoff, NVIDIA operated on a fiscal year ending in late January (reporting periods ended 2024-01-28 and 2025-01-26), whereas AMD and Intel used calendar-aligned fiscal years ending in late December (reporting periods ended 2023-12-30 and 2024-12-28) [E1d1ed85017] [E47912effca] [Ed422eea5f5] [E2e09a06900] [E7a1493ba18] [E9825b28a5f]. NVIDIA achieved massive top-line and operating income expansion [E1d1ed85017] [E47912effca] [E8c58b8d2cd] [Edfa0a58d57]. AMD's revenue contracted in fiscal 2023 before increasing in 2024 [Ed422eea5f5] [E2e09a06900], while Intel's revenue declined consecutively and operating profitability deteriorated into a severe loss by fiscal 2024 [E7a1493ba18] [E9825b28a5f] [Ee7da324732] [E58906c3289]. Peer profit directions diverged significantly [E1d1ed85017] [Ed422eea5f5] [E7a1493ba18].
